body_html:
Pretty work gets attention. Structured facts get shortlisted. You need both on one shareable link.

Designed portfolios often bury education, skills, and contact under animation. ATS-minded readers bounce.

This guide is for candidates designing for how recruiters actually read who want a site that feels intentional — not another generic template dump.

The real problem

Hire Me isn’t a second portfolio. It’s the résumé that never gets lost in email threads.

Do this next

  1. Keep education, skills, and contact scannable on Hire Me
  2. Link Hire Me from your designed home so recruiters choose their path
  3. Print-test the page once — if it looks chaotic on paper, simplify

Design for the skim

Assume ten seconds. If education, skills, and contact aren’t obvious, a busy recruiter won’t hunt. Pair a designed home with a Hire Me page that prints cleanly.

How a website helps you stand out

Recruiters skim for risk reduction: clarity, credibility, and an easy next step. Design for that skim.

On BEXO, that path is simple: discover on mybexo.cyou, create on dash.mybexo.cyou, share on yourname.mybexo.cyou. Premium templates and a Hire Me page give you agency-grade presentation without becoming a full-time webmaster.

Field checklist

  • Above-the-fold clarity in five seconds
  • Proof before personality essays
  • Contact that works on mobile

Try this today

Open your draft (or start one), apply one change from the list above, and publish. Momentum compounds faster than waiting for “ready.”
